'''Zero Gravity Fizzyglug''' was a variant of [[Fizzyglug]], a type of beverage.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the  [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], sold various versions of Fizzyglug including Zero Gravity Fizzyglug for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The diner offered to add flavored syrups to the beverage at no additional charge. These syrups included [[bilaberry]], [[Denta bean/Legends|denta bean]], [[Geldan sun-apple]], [[Ishi Tib-cracked coconut]], [[Jewel-fruit (Mon Calamari)|jewel-fruit]], [[manta pear]], [[nikkle nut]], [[Pallie/Legends|pallie]], [[Roonan lemon]], [[scry-mint]], [[Shuura/Legends|shuura fruit]], [[Sunberry/Legends|sunberry]], [[sweetmelon]], [[Trammistan chocolate]], [[zherry]], and [[zwil]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zero Gravity Fizzyglug was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
